title: Overdue Draw Charges Carried by a Past-Due Reconstruction Draw Payment
content:
A payment that brings a past-due customer-funded draw of a Reconstruction contract current carries the overdue draw charges according to the contract's work status.

**Rule.** The overdue draw charges the payment carries follow the contract's work status:

- while work on the contract is suspended, that is when a suspension date is recorded with no resumption dated on or after it, the payment carries every overdue draw charge posted on the paid draw, which only this payment carries, because a draw it brings current is paid by no other payment of this kind;
- when work is not suspended and overdue draw charges were posted on the paid draw within the past month, it carries those charges, the earlier ones staying on the contract for the final invoice;
- otherwise it carries none.

**The past month.** Counting back one month from the payment date, a date is within the past month when it falls after the same day of the month in the previous calendar month and on or before the payment date; when the previous calendar month has no such day, every date in that previous month is outside the past month.

## Work status read from the contract

| Suspension date | Resumption date | Work suspended |
|---|---|---|
| none recorded | — | no |
| recorded | none recorded | yes |
| recorded | before the suspension date | yes |
| recorded | on or after the suspension date | no |

## Cases (hypothetical figures, payment on the 14th of a month)

Overdue draw charges on the paid draw: $48.00 posted on the 2nd of the previous month and $51.00 posted on the 3rd of this month.

| Work status | Carried |
|---|---|
| suspended | $99.00, every charge on the paid draw |
| not suspended | $51.00, the charge within the past month; the $48.00 stays on the contract for the final invoice |
| not suspended, no charge on the paid draw within the past month | none |
